question.text: Identify the incorrect statement from the following.

options.text: Amylose is a branched chain polymer of glucose
Starch is a polymer of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>D</mi></math> glucose
Glycogen is called as animal starch

solution.text: Amylose is linear chain polymer of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>Glucose</mi></math> whereas amylopectin is branched chain polymer of same compound. Other statements are correct.
